description: This is a test source file containing unit tests for MacGatewayChatTransport mapping functions in a chat application. It verifies correct handling of different event types and their mapping to transport events.

methods.name: snapshot maps to health
methods.description: Test that a snapshot event is correctly mapped to a health transport event.

methods.name: health event maps to health
methods.description: Test that a health event is correctly mapped to a health transport event.

methods.name: tick event maps to tick
methods.description: Test that a tick event is correctly mapped to a tick transport event.

methods.name: chat event maps to chat
methods.description: Test that a chat event with specific payload maps correctly to a chat transport event.

methods.name: unknown event maps to nil
methods.description: Test that an unknown event type results in nil when mapped.

methods.name: seq gap maps to seq gap
methods.description: Test that a sequence gap event maps correctly to a seqGap transport event.
